violations.text: The dumpster outside is located on dirt. The outdoor storage surface for refuse, recyclables, and returnables must be constructed of nonabsorbent material such as concrete or asphalt and must be smooth, durable, and sloped to drain. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the kitchen. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026

Food contact surfaces of the ice machine were observed with an accumulation of soil residue and biofilm. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machine was taken out of service to be cleaned and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

Milk was observed held at 48 degrees Fahrenheit in the nitro refrigerator. Lox was observed held at 46 degrees F in prep unit. Potatoes observed held at 54 degrees F in lowboy. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Milk and lox were placed in freezer to rapidly chill. Potatoes were disposed of. Discussed using a carafe for milk during busy times, and not overfilling pans in prep unit. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

ROP lox was observed thawing in the walk in cooler with packaging intact. Safe Handling practices for ROP Seafood given to PIC. Lox was removed from packaging during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026
Water was observed in cleaned blender, which was not stored inverted. After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils must be air dried. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

Single service items are not being stored properly in their original protective package and/or are stored on a surface that is not clean in the kitchen and front service area. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the prep unit and floor mixer have an accumulation of food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026
